Class PlanetarySystem

java.lang.Object
PlanetarySystem
public class PlanetarySystem extends Object
Represents a planetary system organized as a tree structure, with a star as the root node and planets and satellites as child nodes. Provides methods to manage celestial bodies, analyze sensor data, and generate mission reports.

  • Method Details

    • createPlanetSystem

      public void createPlanetSystem(String starName, double temperature, double pressure, double humidity, double radiation)
      Creates a new planetary system with a star as the root node.
      Parameters:
      starName - the name of the star
      temperature - the temperature of the star (in Kelvin)
      pressure - the pressure of the star (in Pascals)
      humidity - the humidity level (must be zero for stars)
      radiation - the radiation level (in Sieverts)
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a planetary system already exists
      IllegalArgumentException - if humidity is not zero

    • addPlanet

      public void addPlanet(String planetName, String parentName, double temperature, double pressure, double humidity, double radiation)
      Adds a planet to the planetary system under a specified parent node.
      Parameters:
      planetName - the name of the planet
      parentName - the name of the parent node (star or planet)
      temperature - the temperature of the planet (in Kelvin)
      pressure - the pressure of the planet (in Pascals)
      humidity - the humidity level of the planet
      radiation - the radiation level (in Sieverts)

    • addSatellite

      public void addSatellite(String satelliteName, String parentName, double temperature, double pressure, double humidity, double radiation)
      Adds a satellite (moon) to a planet in the planetary system.
      Parameters:
      satelliteName - the name of the satellite
      parentName - the name of the parent planet
      temperature - the temperature of the satellite (in Kelvin)
      pressure - the pressure of the satellite (in Pascals)
      humidity - the humidity level of the satellite
      radiation - the radiation level (in Sieverts)

    • findRadiationAnomalies

      public List<Node> findRadiationAnomalies(double threshold)
      Finds all nodes in the planetary system with radiation levels above a specified threshold.
      Parameters:
      threshold - the radiation threshold (in Sieverts)
      Returns:
      a list of nodes with radiation above the threshold

    • getPathTo

      public Stack<String> getPathTo(String planetName)
      Returns the path from the root star to a specified node.

      Returns:
      a stack containing the names of nodes in the path, or an empty stack if not found
